status: PROPOSED schema; the store is empty by design until official captures exist
rules: A row is written only when the price was captured from a source, never inferred or back-filled.
verified must be 'yes' for a row to count. If verified is not 'yes', line and price_american must be blank.
source_url must be https and on an allow-listed official domain (see scripts/validate_snapshots.py).
origination_order follows the brief: 1 = spread (side), 2 = total, 3 = moneyline. The moneyline is never originated before the side and total.
timing is 'open' or 'close'. A market with only a close row is reported as incomplete, not as a full open/close pair.

columns.side: home | away | over | under | blank for total-only fields
columns.captured_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the capture
columns.book: name of the publisher of the price
columns.line: spread or total number; blank for moneyline
columns.price_american: American odds integer; blank if unverified
columns.source_url: https URL of the official page or capture record
columns.verified_on: YYYY-MM-DD the row was checked against source_url
columns.note: free text, required when verified = no

columns.source_url: official NFL.com page that shows the score
columns.nflverse_committed_snapshot: what the committed third-party snapshot says, for cross-check only
